description: Delete an article (Artikel) by name; its objects stay in the layout. Unknown names are not_found with the available names. A warning comes when no article is left while the tagged PDF is still set to use articles. Returns deleted, article_names[], count and use_for_tagged_pdf.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name.description: Name of the article to delete.

name: delete_article
title: Delete an article
